'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Jared Napolitano LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jared Napolitano]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Watch Your Step
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
